episodes.title: I See Him
episodes.summary: A Saxon forester's son loses everything; a legend is born in blood; the fight for England's soul begins.

episodes.title: A Heinous Devil
episodes.summary: Grief boils into vengeance; Rob crosses a line, and the innocence in him dies; what rises in its place will shape the future of England.

episodes.title: No Man Can Hide Forever
episodes.summary: The death of Huntingdon's son deepens the rift between Normans and Saxons; Rob gains a powerful ally in Little John, but the Sheriff's pursuit grows, driving the outlaws deeper into Sherwood; Marian enters the perilous court in Westminster.

episodes.title: The Cause of This Unrest
episodes.summary: Rob leads a daring heist to steal the Sheriff's own bounty for his capture; success could fund their cause but the risks force every outlaw to face the true cost of rebellion.

episodes.title: Go Back to Them
episodes.summary: When the Millers are captured, Rob leads a daring rescue that earns the Sheriff's wrath; in Westminster, Marian's fragile footing is shaken by the devastating news of her brother's death.

episodes.title: Bound by Love, Divided by Lies
episodes.summary: The Queen's arrival to Nottingham puts the Sheriff in a bind, back her plans or risk his life to avert war; Marian and Rob share a fleeting reunion, cut short when Marian learns of his role in her brother's death.

episodes.title: Thieves with a Purpose
episodes.summary: Rob's secret pact with Eleanor drives him to strike Baron Warick, prompting the Sheriff to jail his uncle Gamewell and Saxon elders; Prince John's appearance sparks an unexpected attraction for Marian, who Eleanor secretly enlists to spy on her son.

episodes.title: The True Price of Defiance
episodes.summary: Rob launches a daring rescue of his uncle and Saxon elders, only to walk into the Sheriff's trap; the death of an outlaw fuels Rob's rage; in Westminster, Marian's growing bond with Prince John makes her mission for Eleanor increasingly dangerous.

episodes.title: I Choose You
episodes.summary: In response to Henry's death, Rob burns Warick's manor and kills Warick, driving Tuck away; the Sheriff visits Eleanor; Prince John uncovers Marian's spying, forcing her to flee with news that the King has sent Guy of Gisborne to kill Rob.

episodes.title: One Enemy Falls, Another Rises
episodes.summary: As Guy of Gisborne embarks to kill Rob, the Sheriff plots against him to draw the King to England; Rob prepares to attack; Marian infiltrates her father's home for intel; the outlaws lead missions crucial to victory; all must succeed, or all die.
